newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Atel confident, but sees limits for gains.
newsitem.headline: Atel confident, but sees limits for gains.

text.p: Swiss utility Aare-Tessin AG fuer Elektrizitaet (Atel) said it was confident for 1997, but there were limits to how much profitability could be improved due to sharper competition.

"Atel is also confident for 1997, but there are tight limits for a further improvement in finance and earnings power -- which already has reached a very high level -- in light of the sharper competition arising from liberalisation of electricity markets," the company quoted its chief executive Walter Buergi as saying.
Atel reported a 1996 net profit of 167 million Swiss francs.
Buergi said Atel was preparing itself for the future challenges and deeper cooperation with foreign and domestic companies was a significant part of continued success.

Atel will continue its efforts to develop suitable alliances as part of its strengthened cooperation with the two new shareholders in Motor-Columbus, France's Electricite de France (EDF) and RWE Energi AG.
